title: MC-EvoBench: Auditing Experience-Driven Self-Improvement in Minecraft Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.13829v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A central challenge in embodied recursive self-improvement is enabling agents to convert interaction history into capabilities that persist beyond one world and transfer to later tasks. A saved memory or successful final action does not by itself establish that a reusable capability was acquired; evaluation must separate capability change from carried-over resources, unequal source exposure, and early execution failures. We construct MC-EvoBench as a controlled Minecraft benchmark with a fixed catalog of 19 registered evolution chains, including 12 primary evaluation chains and seven calibration or probe chains, together with three graph-aligned paired probe families for transfer. The benchmark represents each task as a task-state graph, defines stage-level environment verifiers, assigns matched source and target roles, resets the target world, and permits only a declared agent artifact to cross the source-target boundary. translated_title: MC-EvoBench：审计Minecraft智能体中经验驱动的自我改进
translated_abstract: 具身递归自我改进的核心挑战在于使智能体能够将交互历史转化为超越单一世界持续存在、并可迁移到后续任务的能力。保存的记忆或成功的最终动作本身并不能证明获得了可复用的能力；评估必须将能力变化与遗留资源、不平等的源暴露以及早期执行失败区分开来。我们构建了MC-EvoBench，这是一个受控的Minecraft基准，包含固定的19条已注册进化链目录，其中包括12条主要评估链和7条校准或探测链，并配有三个与图对齐的配对探测族用于迁移评估。该基准将每个任务表示为任务状态图，定义了阶段级环境验证器，分配匹配的源角色与目标角色，重置目标世界，并仅允许一个已声明的智能体工件跨越源-目标边界。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MC-EvoBench是一个受控的Minecraft基准，通过19条注册进化链、任务状态图与严格的源-目标边界控制，审计智能体能否将交互经验真正转化为可跨世界持久化并迁移到后续任务的可复用能力。
en_tdlr: MC-EvoBench is a controlled Minecraft benchmark that uses 19 registered evolution chains, task-state graphs, and strict source-target boundary controls to audit whether agents can genuinely convert interaction experience into reusable capabilities that persist across worlds and transfer to later tasks.
